query:
INSERT INTO businessSportCategories (businessId, sportCategoryId)
SELECT b.id, b.sportCategoryId FROM businesses b
WHERE b.sportCategoryId IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM businessSportCategories bsc 
  WHERE bsc.businessId = b.id AND bsc.sportCategoryId = b.sportCategoryId
);
